title: Hearing on City Hall's use of influencers and civic engagement
summary: The Council's Governmental Operations Committee will hold an oversight hearing on the Mamdani administration's civic engagement efforts, including the new Office of Mass Engagement and City agencies' use of paid social media influencers. The hearing will also examine four related bills that would require disclosure of government-funded online communications, restrict candidates from appearing in them and mandate campaign finance disclosures for social media content. It follows reports that a mayoral Signal chat sharing talking points with influencers used auto-deleting messages.
